default_decision_approach: Prefer a simple season-end league exchange rule when specialised real-world eligibility/licensing/points-gap exceptions block ordinary simulation; retain exact original FC27 clubs and country/tiers; label overrides as game assumptions; do not invent promotion-qualified clubs or activate careers.

decisions.game_playoff_rule: Serie B teams finishing 3rd to 8th contest the final promotion place through a play-off. Always run the play-off, regardless of points gap. The play-off winner is promoted to Serie A alongside the top two; Serie A's bottom three are relegated.
decisions.exception_ignored: Do not use the real-world qualifying points-gap trigger that can bypass the Serie B playoff.
decisions.rationale: Consistent and engaging promotion play-off with exactly three up and three down.

decisions.game_playoff_rule: Straight exchange: the Austrian 2. Liga champion is promoted and the Austrian Bundesliga's last-placed club is relegated. No promotion/relegation match.
decisions.exception_ignored: Ignore Austrian club licensing qualification, exceptional lower-ranked eligible promotions and any possibility of no exchange.
decisions.rationale: One-up one-down each season is easier to simulate and explain.
